tests.name: Repeated minimum
tests.hint: When the minimum is pushed twice, popping one copy shouldn't lose it.

tests.name: 300 random operations
100 000 operations
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(1550)
ops = [('push', random.randint(-10**9, 10**9)) for _ in range(40000)]
for _ in range(30000):
    ops.append(('min',))
    ops.append(random.choice([('push', random.randint(-10**9, 10**9)), ('pop',)]))
tests.hint: Calling min() on the whole stack is O(N). Store the minimum so far with each value.
